title: Sol dynamical-regime classifier training row
description: One v0.24.x ship's 7-feature signature vector + regime label, used as a ground-proof row in the v0.24.9 eigenbasis-projection classifier. Single row_type catalogue ('regime_example'); each row records ship_version + regime_label + description + catalog_module + the 7-feature vector (time_scale_log_s, spatial_scale_log_km, stability_index, has_commensurability, prediction_track_signal, dimensionality, forcing_class_index).

ship_version.description: ephemerides-spectral release version that defined this regime label (e.g., '0.24.0' for Mercury, '0.24.11' for Pluto-Charon).

description.description: Human-readable description of the regime, including the v0.24.x mechanism.

catalog_module.description: Catalog wrapper module name in `_research/` that provides the canonical implementation.

time_scale_log_s.description: log10 of the body / sub-system's natural period in seconds.

spatial_scale_log_km.description: log10 of the natural length scale in kilometres.

has_commensurability.description: 1 if the system carries an observable small-integer commensurability.

prediction_track_signal.description: +1 if the system has a published prediction methodology with HIT-only track record; -1 if a published methodology has been observed to MISS; 0 if no published methodology.

dimensionality.description: 0 = point dynamics, 1 = 1D chain, 2 = 2D surface family, 3 = 3D volume / continuum.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — cross-references, ratchet-pinning observations.

source_doi.description: DOI of the canonical paper most identified with the v0.24.x ship that defined this regime label.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For dataset/program release tags when applicable.
